verdict.rationale: Base44 has first-party documentation dedicated to connecting a custom domain to a published app, including brand rationale (docs-26, docs-32) and automatic SSL issuance/renewal once the domain is connected (docs-8). This directly matches the founder story with clear, specific first-party docs. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on community confirmation of the domain-connection flow working, and no detail on DNS record setup steps or edge cases.
